case.title: Two empty open_text answers by the same contributor do not count as duplicates
case.why: The rule says empty open_text never fires. A naive implementation computes Jaccard of two empty sets, then either treats 0/0 as 1.0 (identical, so it fires) or crashes on division by zero. Same contributor and same device are both true here, so only the empty-text exemption keeps the check silent. Other checks are quiet: durations of 24 and 28 min, different days, daytime, points inside Kondele, single contributor on the device, no transcript.
